Each Lloyd iteration reassigns every point, then moves each center to the mean of its members, c_k = sum x_i / n_k, summed in fixed order. A center that gets no point is relocated to the points farthest from their centers. formula.ascii: Objective, not the procedure: inertia J = sum over valid points i of |x_i - c_l(i)|^2, with l(i) the nearest center (lowest center id wins ties) in f32. Each Lloyd iteration reassigns every point, then moves each center to the mean of its members, c_k = sum x_i / n_k, summed in fixed order. A center that gets no point is relocated to the points farthest from their centers. Initial centers are k-means++ (seeded) or the first k valid points; with restarts the lowest J wins.
